NSCameraUsageDescription: PushApp lets you take a photo for something you are writing. It stays on this phone.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PushApp lets you attach a photo to something you are writing. It stays on this phone.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: PushApp saves your completion card to your photos, only when you tap Save.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: PushApp records a voice note only when you tap record, and it stays on this phone.
